v1.4.0 Update
- Added the Organizations & Reputation window for shared organizations, their members and roles, and Actor reputation.
- The relationship map has an Organizations view in all six themes.
- Organizations can hold suborganizations, a chain of command, a History log, and relationships with each other.
- GMs can hide organizations or members from players and arrange the organization map for everyone.
- The Manager's preset list can be sorted, and the windowed tracker has a drag grip.

announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.4.0
announcement.content:
Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.4.0 adds shared organizations and an organization map.

  • The Organizations & Reputation window keeps each organization's emblem, colour, description, members, and roles. Actor reputation entries can link to an organization and follow its name and emblem.
  • Switch the relationship map to Organizations to see members grouped by organization, with labelled lines for the relationships between organizations. Each of the six themes draws its own outlines.
  • A member can report to another member, and the map draws that roster as a chart. Suborganizations appear inside their parent's area.
  • Organizations have a History tab, and relationships between organizations have their own rank and log. New entries start as GM-only.
  • GMs can hide an organization, its member list, or single members from players, and can arrange the organization map for every participant.
